IEA and WBCSD Cement Sustainability Initiative (2018). Technology Roadmap: Low-Carbon Transition in the Cement Industry. International Energy Agency, Paris, and World Business Council for Sustainable Development, Geneva, March 2018. www.iea.org/technology-roadmap/cement; www.wbcsdcement.org/technology. No DOI or ISBN printed.

Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 2). The report gives few technology-level numbers; most are reprinted from ECRA and CSI (2017) (CSI-ECRA 2017, also in the _high queue) and tagged so. Main file: state-of-the-art dry precalciner kiln 3.0-3.4 GJ/t clinker; PC clinker process CO2 0.52 t/t; chemical-absorption capture (yield up to 95%; energy penalty 1.0-3.5 GJ/t clinker heat and 50-90 kWh/t clinker electricity, INCREMENTAL to average operation, not absolute); partial (55-75%) and full (90-99%) oxy-fuel and membrane (60-70%) capture yields; calcium looping, LEILAC indirect calciner; CO2 abatement cost 55-70 (oxy-fuel) and 90-150 (post-combustion) 2015 USD/t CO2 avoided (fn 41 states 2015 USD), excluding transport and storage; mineral carbonation 3 GJ/t CO2; alternative binders (belite, CSA, BCSA, CACS, PHCS, MOMS, alkali-activated) with process-CO2 reductions and state of development; grinding mills and EHR power as descriptions. No numeric TRLs printed (state-of-development rows only). No per-technology capex/opex printed anywhere; investment figures are scenario totals (_other-values). Not loaded: bar heights of Figs 2 and 8-18 (no printed labels); scenario results and sector statistics (selected rows in _other-values); relative savings (in _measures). Thermal intensities have no stated heating-value basis; fn 27 says fuel calorific values are net. Trap: Table 2 split across printed pp.18-19; Fig. 9 text layer is garbled.
